narr: Slow moving thunderstorms formed along the higher terrain of the Allegheny Mountains before slowly drifting eastward. This resulted in a localized two to four inches of rain across parts of Mineral County and flash flooding.
ev: Small rock slides and six inches of flowing water across Knobley Road at WV-46 Fort Ashby Road, and on Waxler Road at Suter Lane near Keyser.
